test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**spend**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The verb "to" is followed by the **base form** of a verb (also called infinitive form) without "to" being part of the verb itself.
 
• In the sentence, "to spend the day" is an infinitive phrase indicating **purpose** or **intention**.
 
• Only option 2, "**spend**", is in the correct base form and fits grammatically after "to".
 
• Other options like "spent" (past tense), "spends" (present tense), and "spending" (gerund) are not correct after "to".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *My parents and younger sister had gone to my uncle's house to spend__ the day.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• "Spent" is past tense (e.g., They spent the day at home) — incorrect here.
 
• "Spends" is third person singular present (e.g., She spends too much time reading) — incorrect here.
 
• "Spending" is the gerund or present participle (e.g., Spending time with family is fun) — not used after "to".
